ABOUT

About epona

Interior Photo

epona is a reservation-only restaurant hosting just one party at a time. We serve nothing but a monthly-changing omakase course made with seasonal ingredients and vegetables and herbs from our own garden.

We take reservations first, then source ingredients and cook each dish at its best moment for your visit — which is why we operate by reservation only. Our bread, made with pesticide-free wheat, is also baked fresh to match your reservation time, and our sommelier prepares a drink pairing for each course.

  • Curated Ingredients Seasonal ingredients and vegetables & herbs from our own garden
  • Reservation Hours Lunch 11:30〜 / Dinner 18:00〜
    (One party per seating)
  • Closed Wednesdays & the 3rd Tuesday of the month
  • Accessibility We also offer sign language assistance (still learning). Wheelchairs and guide dogs are welcome.
  • Families Welcome As we host only one party at a time, you can relax even with small children.
